sequence.stop: arm handled; Away turns the lights off

description: Ten minutes after the last person leaves (zone.home counts all three phones, so a child home alone is not 'empty'), ONE note to both adults: which lights are still on (sensor.lighting_left_on), and - unless the alarm is already Away, arming or going off - an offer to arm Away (operator 2026-10-14). Nothing happens without a button. Arm Away is honoured only if the house is still empty when it is pressed. Each button press is awaited for up to two hours; after the lights button the arm offer stays open for another two. Someone coming home clears the note. Tests: tests/climate/cases.py (everyone left). Review 2026-10-14: L1 - the second wait re-reads the alarm live; L2 - once handled, the note is cleared on both phones. Operator 2026-10-14: a child can be home with a sitter and neither has a tracked phone. Names in input_text.house_untracked_people (comma-separated) turn the offer into a question - 'Is <name> with you?' - and the arm button into the yes. No answer is a no: the alarm is left as it is. Any future automatic (geofenced) arming must ask the same way.
